Default package author

Source: R/author.R
kpkg_author.Rd

The author written in the Authors@R field of the packages created with create_pkg(). Another author can be used by setting the option kpkg.r.author to a utils::person(), e.g. in your .Rprofile.

Usage

kpkg_author()

Value

A utils::person() object.

Examples

kpkg_author()
#> [1] "Kevin Bosirany Orlando <kevinbosirany@gmail.com> [aut, cre] (ORCID: <https://orcid.org/0009-0009-2784-3108>)"

# Use another author for the current session
old <- options(
  kpkg.r.author = person("Jane", "Doe", role = c("aut", "cre"))
)
kpkg_author()
#> [1] "Jane Doe [aut, cre]"
options(old)
